**Finding submitted — deviation on § 14.2 (IP ownership of Deliverables).**

- **Problem:** Vendor took exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created for us, leaving only a revocable, non-transferable, Order Form–term licence. That fails even the fallback (no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, modifiable/sublicensable Deliverable licence); § 13.2's perpetual paid-up licence covers only Vendor Technology *embedded in* a Deliverable, not the Deliverable itself.
- **Already compliant elsewhere (left untouched):** § 14.1 (our Customer Data and independent IP; Vendor's limited processing right, reinforced by § 15.1), § 14.3 (Vendor retains pre-existing Vendor Technology), § 13.2 (perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free embedded licence), § 14.4 (no joint ownership).
- **Cure:** one surgical replacement of § 14.2 flipping ownership to Customer for Deliverables and work product with a Vendor assignment, deleting the now-redundant revocable licence. No collateral cross-references to § 14.2 exist.
